title: Replace the compaction summary instead of starting a new session
body: The handoff overwrites OpenCode's compaction result with the boot packet, so the session keeps its id and title and peers can still reach it. A new session would have lost the peer address.

title: Learner data lives in the store, outside the graph
body: Learner state is tables beside the journal, not nodes: agents can read what the human knows through learner_profile, while the index, exports and change log stay free of a daily time series. Chosen over a separate learn.db so agents can calibrate to the human.
